newsitem.title: ITALY: STET shares start lower on Milan bourse.
newsitem.headline: STET shares start lower on Milan bourse.

text.p: Shares in Italian state-controlled telecoms holding company STET opened 4.14 percent lower at 7,210 lire on the Milan bourse after the Italian lower house of parliament voted late Wednesday against the transfer of STET to the Treasury.
STET savings shares started off 4.28 percent at 5,210 lire.
Italy's centre-left government was defeated on the vote after the hard-left Communist Refoundation, which guarantees the government majority in the lower house, abstained.
But later on Wednesday the Italian Treasury said the vote would not sink the transfer plan because it was attached to part of the 1997 budget and effectively had "already taken place".
The transfer of shares from state holding group IRI to the Treasury was announced in November as part of a plan to merge STET with Telecom Italia and privatise the merged company.
